# Scheme fixtures

`polycarp theme import` tests read these files. They are copied unchanged from
[tinted-theming/schemes](https://github.com/tinted-theming/schemes) at commit
`1bd5ad4c2c554c9c8e288b56deab2364ac8dada0`, which is MIT licensed (see `LICENSE` here).

| File | Source | System | Variant |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gruvbox-dark-hard.yaml` | `base16/gruvbox-dark-hard.yaml` | base16 | dark |
| `rose-pine-dawn.yaml` | `base16/rose-pine-dawn.yaml` | base16 | light |
| `dracula.yaml` | `base24/dracula.yaml` | base24 | dark |
